title: Vaaimaiye Vellum
desc: Raja is hired by a journalist, who is investigating the kidnapping of rich children, to protect his daughter. In turn, Raja earns the enmity of the criminals behind the operation.

title: Kedi
desc: Raghu, a happy-go-lucky college student, faces challenges when two girls from different backgrounds fall in love with him.

title: Maasilamani
desc: Maasilamani falls in love with a woman, Divya, who dislikes him. Trouble ensues when he concocts an elaborate story about his lookalike to win her heart.

title: Malabar Police
desc: After running away together, two people witness the murder of a minister. Later, the police officer assigned to investigate the case embarks on a mission to find them.

title: Muthukku Muthaaga
desc: A couple faces challenges to raise their five sons without compromising on their needs. After the children grow up and get married, it gets difficult for them to stay in a joint family.
